scope: City of Coffs Harbour Council by-election

sources.title: NSWEC City of Coffs Harbour Council by-election ballot paper draw order
sources.supports: Post-draw candidate table lists 5 candidates in official ballot order, with affiliations as printed. Kyal Towells’s ballot affiliation field is blank.

sources.title: NSWEC City of Coffs Harbour Council by-election notice of contested election
sources.supports: Election notice 3 dated 12 November confirms a contested poll on 12 December, 8 am–6 pm AEDT, with postal receipt by 6 pm AEDT on 29 December.

observations: City of Coffs Harbour Council by-election: Nominations closed at noon AEDT on 11 November. NSWEC published 5 candidates in the 12 November ballot draw order. Voting remains scheduled for 12 December, 8 am to 6 pm AEDT. Postal vote receipt closes 29 December at 6 pm AEDT.
